skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze concepts and approaches in tourism geography, including tourism systems, tourist demand, resources, and infrastructure.
Analyze and evaluate statistical information on tourism resources, infrastructure, and technical facilities in various territories.
Develop sales strategies for tourist destinations based on cross-selling, upselling, and after-sales services.
Analyze geographical characteristics of continents, regions, and countries around the world, as well as in Vietnam.
Demonstrate responsibility and creativity in learning, and a positive attitude towards protecting and utilizing tourism resources sustainably.
Apply critical thinking to evaluate and analyze tourism-related data and information.
Participate actively in group discussions and presentations, demonstrating effective communication and teamwork.
